name: create_customers
statements: create table public.customers (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, email text not null unique, full_name text not null, country text, created_at timestamptz not null default now());

name: create_orders
statements:
create type order_status as enum ('pending','paid','shipped','refunded','cancelled');
create table public.orders (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, customer_id bigint not null references public.customers(id), status order_status not null default 'pending', total numeric not null, currency text not null default 'USD', created_at timestamptz not null default now());

name: enable_rls_customers_orders
statements:
alter table public.customers enable row level security;
alter table public.orders enable row level security;

name: create_invoices
statements: create table public.invoices (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, order_id bigint not null references public.orders(id), number text not null unique, amount numeric not null, issued_at timestamptz not null default now(), pdf_path text);
